decisions.summary: MysteryMarket is presented as operational audit/fieldwork execution, not as a full-service competing evaluation/reporting agency.
The Verify system is strategically reusable and should be preserved for reuse in other INSODEMA products/projects.
Public customer/partner relationships are only named in approved factual contexts; sensitive credential details may be code-gated.
Credential photos, logos and evidence documents live outside the public webroot and are served only through authenticated/verified asset delivery.
docs/ and source coordination material must not be synchronized into the public production web artifact. HTTP deny rules are defence in depth only.
Current Audits is removed from primary navigation and retained only as a supporting footer destination; it is not positioned as a public reference showcase.
The public Verify entry point is mysterymarket.de/verify without a .php suffix; legacy /verify.php remains internally compatible.
Public contact email addresses should not be present as directly readable mailto/plain addresses in initial HTML; they are reconstructed client-side as a pragmatic anti-scraping measure.
MysteryMarket V1 will release with the established light layout; the experimental dark concept theme will not be publicly selectable.

MysteryMarket Elite provides private member information and may announce project opportunities seen by the admin; ShopperMatch remains a separate job/matching system and is not mixed into each MysteryMarket project post.
R1.2 will target a real Apple Wallet pass for Elite Shopper credentials, with MysteryMarket Verify remaining authoritative.
Use ATLAS as the central location/address source for country/postal/city/region data rather than duplicating a global dataset inside MysteryMarket.
Green means OK/active/approved; amber means open/new/draft/requested/parked; red means rejected/suspended/ended/expired/failed; blue/grey is informational/neutral.
Credentials belong to a person/identity independently of admin/Elite role so admins can also hold and view their own credentials.
Apple Wallet is a first-class issuance option inside 'Ausweis bestellen', using the same credential identity/lifecycle as physical outputs.

decisions.source_authority: ATLAS approved shared INSODEMA geography contract
decisions.summary: MysteryMarket consumes ATLAS Geography Reference API v1 server-to-server using its own MYSTERYMARKET token and canonical ATLAS IDs.
Superseded: the initial generic role-independent credential-subject model was too broad and would have created a parallel MysteryMarket credential.

R1.2 is a creation/output/fulfilment service for project-specific personal audit_verifications credentials. Verify remains authoritative; Wallet, print and physical cards are representations of the same project credential.

R1.2 remains printer-independent. Zebra is not selected; a Canon or other printer with card/tray feed may be used later. Device-specific printing will only be designed after the actual printer model is chosen.

The project-specific Verify/Credential/Wallet implementation is intentionally a reusable subsystem for later products. Future ports must preserve one authoritative credential, protected assets, shared integrity gating, revision lifecycle, output references and Verify authority while replacing product-specific branding, URLs, scopes, auth/audit adapters and Apple signing identity.

Apple Developer setup should be created as a clean long-term INSODEMA foundation, not as a Wallet-only throwaway account. It should support future App Store application publishing as well as PassKit/Wallet.

Public Verify is verification-only. Private card/Wallet representations require Backoffice authentication. Admin may access all credentials; Elite may access only credentials explicitly bound through audit_verifications.subject_user_id.
